levels.surface: المظفر بن جعفر بن المظفر العلوي

notes: «عن أخيه موسى بن جعفر عليهما السلام» : the relation word and the name are one link, and the name stands alone (rule 7)
the Imam is named inside the chain after «عن», so he is a narrator; his words follow
«وفي حديث آخر» opens a second saying with no isnad: it is not a route
